digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend assembly and port conformance
propositions: The JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend protocol because it lacks query_project and assert_env_ready methods that Cloud's JiraBackend implements
The reconciler.backend config validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' as a choice despite the backend being registered and resolvable through the adapter registry

DC inbound assignees fail to mint identities because the guard in _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity requires accountId but DC users carry only name/key, and the backend vendor 'jira-datacenter' is not in the CREATION_CHANNELS vocabulary
The TicketTransport protocol declares only six methods but the core calls set_entity_property from three sites, causing a writing reconcile pass against DC to crash with AttributeError
FakeTransport lacks probe_remote, which JiraDataCenterBackend delegates, leaving the delegation untestable at the contract tier
